definitions.old_controls: The 200 parameter IDs present in retained revision .4 inventory.
definitions.base_vca_only: Among old controls, only ch1/ch2_v_level changes after excluding master volume. This changes base level relative to touch, not a new oscillator/filter/envelope recipe.
definitions.mechanism: A configured audible piano (1), non-Kalimba tine (2) or reed (3) rank. Configuration coverage is not an acoustic-realism result.

limitations: No PCM rendering, listening, acoustic measurement or native qualification is performed here.
This reconstructs parameter comparisons from durable old bytes and a fresh independent current capture; it does not recover lost original .8 probe files.
